Park, Sandavellur C Village, Chennai) shows "Total Shipments 148017" and "Latest Cargo 2026-02-28". Exact record line: "2026-02-28 | FLEXTRONICS TECHNOLOGIES (INDIA) PRIVATE LIMITED | JUNIPER NETWORKS INTERNATIONAL B.V | PWR-MX960-4100-DC-S/MX960/480 4100W DC POWER, SPARE/QCS2804V0R0/GOODS ARE BEING EXPORTED AFTER REPAIR/BOE-7269750- | BANGALORE ACC INBLR4, India | AMSTERDAM SCHIPHOL, NETHERLANDS | 85044090 | 1108442". Additional rows seen in the same table: 2026-02-28 BANGALORE ACC -> LOUISVILLE KY, UNITED STATES, HS 85176290, BOL 1108445 (Juniper JNP10K-RE1-E, "GOODS ARE BEING EXPORTED AFTER REPAIR"); 2026-02-28 BANGALORE ACC -> SINGAPORE, HS 85176290, BOL 1108444 (UPS SCS Singapore, PTX10002-36QDD-S). Source counter: page states 148,017 total shipments; 5 rows actually visible in the free view (2 of them are import-direction rows from Celestica de Monterrey, Mexico/US, HS 85411000 / 85423900, BOL 1107111 / 1107278). Declared HS 851718 (telephone sets) does not match the observed export HS codes 85176290 (network equipment) and 85044090 (power supplies) — HS to be corrected to actual, not a rejection ground.
domestic_evidence: No public domestic-supply record retrieved. GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender awards and annual-report India revenue splits were not accessible: thecompanycheck.com returned HTTP 403 and web_search was unavailable (searx connection refused) during this run. ImportKey shows only customs (cross-border) records, which do not evidence domestic Indian sales. No domestic figure is asserted; field left null rather than estimated.
note: Real cross-border shipments are documented, not merely claimed: dated customs/B-L records with destination, HS code and BOL number, latest 2026-02-28, out of Bangalore ACC and Chennai Air Cargo. Important nuance for the buyer: several of the visible export rows are repair-and-return movements ("GOODS ARE BEING EXPORTED AFTER REPAIR", BOE references), i.e. the entity operates as a contract-manufacturing/repair hub for Juniper, Cisco, Samsung, Flex El Paso etc., so export activity is confirmed but the visible sample is dominated by RMA/repair flows rather than fresh-goods sales. Domestic (India) supply side is unverified — status unknown, not 'none_found', because the check could not be completed (403 / search outage), so this must be re-run before any domestic conclusion. HS mismatch: declared 851718 vs observed 85176290 and 85044090 — per project rule 3 the company is retained and the code corrected to the factual one; verdict accepted_hs_corrected. No sanctions/court/ownership issues assessed here (out of scope for this role). Revenue and export volume values: null — ImportKey free view gives shipment counts (148,017) but no value figures, and no revenue data was retrievable.
